description: Defines a SwiftUI ViewModifier `GatewayTrustPromptAlert` for presenting an alert that prompts the user to trust a network gateway during TLS connection. It manages the trust prompt state via environment and presents options to accept or decline trust.

classes.name: GatewayTrustPromptAlert
classes.description: A SwiftUI ViewModifier that shows a trust prompt alert during TLS connection to a gateway.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the view content that conditionally shows an alert for trusting a gateway.

methods.name: promptBinding
methods.description: Binds the alert's visibility to the pending trust prompt state in the environment.
